capabilities: Insert a selected emotion at the cursor position
Customize the list of emotions in settings
Insert emotions as plain text, [[link]], or #tag
Capitalize the word and add a trailing comma after it
extras: README is short; no usage examples or screenshots, though settings options are described.
motivation: The README states the primary purpose is to provide an easier way to add entries to a daily journal or emotions/mood tracker.
problem: Typing emotions manually into daily journal or mood-tracker entries is slow; Obsidian has no built-in picker for reusable emotion words.
summary: Emotion picker that inserts a selected emotion at the cursor as text, a link, or a tag, for mood tracking and journal entries.
